CSS for the colour spans of tab_md

Source: R/tab_md.R
tab_md_css.Rd

A thin wrapper around tab_css(chrome = FALSE), kept for discoverability alongside tab_md. The stylesheet does not depend on the table – classes name a palette slot, not a break – so tabs is ignored and one stylesheet styles every table in a document.

Usage

tab_md_css(tabs = NULL, ...)

Arguments

tabs

Ignored (the CSS is table-independent). Kept so tab_md_css(tabs) still reads naturally.

...

Passed to tab_css (theme, style_tag, file).

Value

A character string of CSS (invisible when file is given).

See also

tab_css(), which is the generator and also styles tab_kable(engine = "html").

Examples

cat(tab_md_css())
#> <style>
#> .p1,.p2,.p3,.p4,.m1,.m2,.m3,.m4{font-weight:bold;}
#> .p1{color:#02A5B3;}
#> .p2{color:#0891C9;}
#> .p3{color:#0267C7;}
#> .p4{color:#300DFD;}
#> .m1{color:#DCA331;}
#> .m2{color:#DE7C01;}
#> .m3{color:#DD5301;}
#> .m4{color:#D60103;}
#> .o1{background-color:#DFFCFF;}
#> .o2{background-color:#D7EFFF;}
#> .o3{background-color:#CEE3FF;}
#> .o4{background-color:#BBCCFF;}
#> .u1{background-color:#FFF4E1;}
#> .u2{background-color:#FFE6D3;}
#> .u3{background-color:#FFD7C8;}
#> .u4{background-color:#FFBAAF;}
#> </style>
